players.product: HYFT biological representation, ReefIQ data layer and LensAI platform for AI drug discovery

quarterly_data.signal: TDP-43 neurodegeneration program (Q1 FY2027 MD&A): generated through a client-driven engagement using MindWalk's integrated discovery platform and, per the company, externally peer-reviewed (bioRxiv, DOI: 10.1101/2025.06.10.658846). MindWalk says the work demonstrated its ability to discriminate with structural precision between toxic and healthy protein conformations - a long-standing challenge in neurodegeneration drug development - and now serves as a validation reference supporting expanded engagement across the neurodegenerative drug discovery community; the result was achieved through MindWalk's wet lab infrastructure.

Program detail (Q1 FY2027 MD&A, beyond the stages already recorded): universal dengue vaccine - a conserved discontinuous epitope identified across all 4 serotypes, rabbit immunization completed and serum antibody binding analysis underway alongside third-party neutralization testing; universal influenza (research stage) - the functional constraint spans Influenza A (H3N2, H5, H7, H9, H1N1 swine) and both Influenza B lineages (Victoria and Yamagata); longevity companion therapeutic - targets a distinct, non-overlapping longevity pathway, target undisclosed pending IP protection. Vault indications: CD3 Fabs (MDWK-24) engineered to reduce cytokine release relative to first-generation CD3 engagers; ALK-1 agonist antibodies (MDWK-21) for vascular pathologies including diabetic retinopathy and pulmonary arterial hypertension; TrkB x CD3 bispecific (MDWK-200) targeting triple-negative breast cancer and other TrkB-overexpressing solid tumors; SARS-CoV-2 (MDWK-03) is the most clinically advanced asset in the Vault by stage. Active R&D at all sites advances internal discovery programs focused on novel therapeutic antibodies, primarily in immuno-oncology. The MD&A says all pipeline programs are at early stages and remain subject to substantial scientific, clinical, regulatory and financing risks.
